about_the_game:
AFK Companion - Never Go Idle Again!

Keep your status active when you need it most! AFK Companion is a lightweight, cross-platform desktop utility designed to prevent automatic idle detection across games, applications, and communication platforms. Perfect for gamers, streamers, and professionals who need to maintain an active status during extended sessions.

🎮 Gaming Focused Features

  • Prevent automatic disconnection from game lobbies and servers

  • Stay online during long matchmaking queues

  • Maintain party leadership during breaks

  • Compatible with ALL games and platforms

  • Smart anti-detection algorithms

⚡ Intelligent Automation

Experience seamless background operation with our advanced automation system:

  • Customizable movement intervals (5 seconds to 5 minutes)

  • Minimal, invisible mouse movements that won't interfere with gameplay

  • Smart pixel-distance control for maximum discretion

  • Scroll Lock toggle for instant on/off control

  • Multiple use case presets (Gaming, Work, Streaming)

📊 Advanced Statistics & Monitoring

Track your productivity and gaming sessions:

  • Real-time session monitoring

  • Total runtime and action counters

  • Session duration analytics

  • Persistent data across app restarts

  • Export statistics for analysis

🔧 Seamless System Integration

  • System tray minimization for background operation

  • Cross-platform support (Windows, macOS & Linux)

  • Lightweight resource usage (< 50MB RAM)

Perfect For These Scenarios:

🎯 Gaming Situations:

  • Long queue times in competitive ranked games

  • AFK farming in idle/incremental games

  • Maintaining lobby presence during bathroom breaks

  • Stream setup and preparation time

  • Tournament waiting periods

💼 Professional Applications:

  • Extended presentations and webinars

  • Video calls and online meetings

  • Remote work session maintenance

  • Content creation workflows

  • Online training sessions

🔒 Privacy & Security First

Your privacy is our priority:

  • 100% local operation - NO network connections

  • Zero data collection or telemetry

  • Safe, non-intrusive automation methods

  • No admin privileges required

✨ Modern Interface Design

Experience our sleek, user-friendly interface featuring:

  • Clean tabbed navigation system

  • Real-time status indicators

  • Animated loading screens

  • Intuitive control panels

Why Choose AFK Companion?

Unlike other anti-idle solutions, AFK Companion offers:

  • Universal Compatibility: Works with any application or game

  • Professional Grade: Built with Electron for reliability

  • Active Development: Regular updates and new features

  • Zero Learning Curve: Intuitive interface, works instantly

Download Now and Never Worry About Going Idle Again!

Perfect for competitive gamers who can't afford to lose their spot in ranked queues, content creators managing long streams, or professionals maintaining presence during extended online sessions.

Credits & Acknowledgments

  • Andorra One Font - Beautiful typography for the interface

  • Electron Framework - Cross-platform desktop application framework

  • Nut.js Library - Reliable cross-platform automation

  • TypeScript - Type-safe development environment

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 (or equivalent mainstream distribution)
  • Processor: 2.5 GHz dual-core or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GT 320 (1 GB VRAM), AMD Radeon HD 5570, or Intel HD 4600 equivalent
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Tarball distribution tested on x64; dependencies like libx11 and libinput required

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.13 (High Sierra) or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core 2 Duo
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
